steps.message: What was the total duration of mountain biking activities in the OpenTracks app this week? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer in minutes as a single integer.

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "cmd package query-content-providers --brief --user 0 de.dennisguse.opentracks; content query --uri content://de.dennisguse.opentracks >/dev/null 2>&1; echo base_uri_exit:$?; for u in content://de.dennisguse.opentracks/tracks content://de.dennisguse.opentracks.trackpoints content://de.dennisguse.opentracks.stats content://de.dennisguse.opentracks.activities content://de.dennisguse.opentracks/content/tracks content://de.dennisguse.opentracks.contentprovider/tracks; do echo URI:$u; content query --uri $u --limit 1 2>&1 | head -n 4; done; ls -la /data/data/de.dennisguse.opentracks 2>&1 | head -n 5; run-as de.dennisguse.opentracks ls -la 2>&1 | head -n 20"
